scripts.build: npm run lor:materialize && npm run lor:check && node --test tests/lor-studio/http-runtime.test.mjs tests/lor-studio/frontend-adapter.test.mjs
scripts.lor:check: node --check server.mjs && node --check lib/auth/session-token.mjs && node --check public/lor-studio/production-adapter.js && node -e "const fs=require('node:fs');const cp=require('node:child_process');const roots=['lor-studio','scripts/lor-studio'];const files=[];function walk(root){for(const entry of fs.readdirSync(root,{withFileTypes:true})){const file=root+'/'+entry.name;if(entry.isDirectory())walk(file);else if(/\.(?:js|mjs)$/.test(entry.name))files.push(file)}}for(const root of roots)walk(root);if(files.length===0)throw new Error('No LOR source or script files found');for(const file of files.sort()){const result=cp.spawnSync(process.execPath,['--check',file],{stdio:'inherit'});if(result.status!==0)process.exit(result.status??1)}"
scripts.lor:artifacts: node --test tests/lor-studio/artifact-security.test.mjs && sh -c 'artifact_root=$(mktemp -d "${TMPDIR:-/tmp}/f2-lor-1010-artifacts.XXXXXX") || exit 1; cleanup_artifacts() { artifact_name="${artifact_root##*/}"; case "$artifact_name" in f2-lor-1010-artifacts.??????) if [ -e "$artifact_root" ]; then rm -rf -- "$artifact_root"; fi ;; *) echo "Refusing unsafe artifact cleanup path" >&2; return 1 ;; esac; }; trap cleanup_artifacts EXIT; trap "exit 129" HUP; trap "exit 130" INT; trap "exit 143" TERM; artifact_status=0; TMPDIR="$artifact_root" node scripts/lor-studio/verify-artifacts.mjs || artifact_status=$?; cleanup_artifacts; cleanup_status=$?; trap - EXIT HUP INT TERM; [ "$artifact_status" -eq 0 ] && [ "$cleanup_status" -eq 0 ]'
